title: feat: P2 spec protocol bridges + P3 mobile testing infrastructure
body:
Completes P2 (Advanced Views & Features) and P3 (Mobile Testing & QA) from the roadmap. Protocol alignment moves from ~55% → ~85%.

### Spec Protocol Bridges (`packages/core/src/protocols/`)

Five new bridge modules that transform `@objectstack/spec` schemas into runtime-usable configs:

- **DndProtocol** — `resolveDndConfig`, `createDragItemProps`, `createDropZoneProps`, `resolveDragConstraints`
- **KeyboardProtocol** — `parseShortcutKey`, `matchesShortcut`, `resolveKeyboardConfig`, `createFocusTrapConfig`
- **NotificationProtocol** — `specNotificationToToast`, `mapSeverityToVariant`, `mapPosition`
- **ResponsiveProtocol** — `getVisibilityClasses`, `getColumnClasses`, `getOrderClasses`, `shouldHideAtBreakpoint`
- **SharingProtocol** — `resolveSharingConfig`, `resolveEmbedConfig`, `generateEmbedCode`, `validateSharingConfig`

```typescript
import { parseShortcutKey, matchesShortcut } from '@object-ui/core';

const parsed = parseShortcutKey('Ctrl+Shift+S');
// { key: 's', ctrlOrMeta: true, shift: true, alt: false }

const matches = matchesShortcut(keyboardEvent, 'Ctrl+S');
```

### Type Re-exports (`packages/types/src/index.ts`)

Added missing `@objectstack/spec/ui` re-exports: `SharingConfig`, `EmbedConfig`, `AddRecordConfig`, `AppearanceConfig`, `UserActionsConfig`, `ViewTab` + their Zod schemas.

### Dashboard BI (P2.4)

`DashboardRenderer` now renders `schema.header` (title, description, action buttons), accepts `recordCount` badge prop and `userActions` config.

### P3 Mobile Testing

- `e2e/mobile-visual-regression.spec.ts` — screenshot comparison at 3 breakpoints
- `e2e/mobile-touch-interaction.spec.ts` — tap targets, swipe, pinch-to-zoom
- `e2e/mobile-keyboard.spec.ts` — on-screen keyboard focus/input
- `e2e/mobile-performance.spec.ts` — 4× CPU throttle load budget, CLS, interaction latency
- `mobile-accessibility.test.tsx` — axe-core WCAG 2.1 AA at mobile viewport
- `.storybook/preview.ts` — viewport presets (iPhone SE/14, iPad Mini, Pixel 5)

### Test Coverage

118 new tests across 8 files. Full suite: 5,070 tests / 290 files, all green.
